title: 第一卷 人生初见 第十三章 变天第一卷 人生初见 第十四章 危局与破局
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
此时的南宫傲被长孙气得不轻，一时竟不知该怎么反驳。
倒是蒙执适时护主，开口说道：“少主，你怎能对老祖宗和副团长如此无理！”
“那你又有什么资格这样对我说话？”长孙平静的反问，
蒙执顿时面红耳赤。
“好了，蒙执，退下吧。”这一会功夫，南宫傲便恢复了冷静。
“长孙，我倒低估了你，看来这几个月在贫民窟还是学到了点本事，只是你这个继承人的位置今天怕是保不住。”南宫傲此刻平静的说道，但话语的直白表明他已经要把最后的窗贴纸捅破。
长孙见南宫傲此时的平静，知道自己的计谋怕是没用了，说道：“副团长此话怎讲，为何我保不住了？”
“此刻的形势你还看不清楚么？”南宫傲双手一摊，此刻支持南宫傲的势力都看着长孙，形势已经很明显了。
“我认为可能没看清楚的是你。”长孙不为所动。
“南宫副团长，我认为长孙家主身体尚好，此时提继承人的事怕是不合适。”
“而且长孙家主智勇双谋，看人更是有独到的眼光，副团长不就是被长孙家主提拔的么，而您更是证明了长孙家主的眼光没错。我相信长孙少主也不会辜负长孙家主的。”司琴此时开口道，语气让人挑不出任何毛病，但态度也表达的很明确。
南宫傲没有想到此时竟然有人会站出来支持长孙。
“司琴姑娘你的意思是？”
“我的意思副团长应该已经明白，这也是红袖阁的意思。”司琴接着回答道。
“海家认为司琴姑娘说得对，红袖阁的决定海家愿全力支持。”海家家主海大富说道。
海家在丽山城内一直算是不问世事的家族，只经商不参与城内的家族纷争，这是海家一贯的态度。
海家不说话但没有人会认为海家没有说话的话语权，更没人敢轻视海家。
海家是城内富甲一方的家族，从历代家主的名字便可见一斑，海家这代家主叫海大富，而他的父亲名叫海巨富。
没有人知道海家有多少钱，也没有人知道海家的背景有多深，只知道海家不能招惹。
此时海家站队让所有人大吃一惊，没有人想到海家会在这样的会议中表明态度，而且更没有人想到海家会支持红袖阁。

从海家家主刚才的话语中能看出海家似乎跟红袖阁关系不一般。
此时人们对于红袖阁更加忌惮了几分。
场内各家主因为海家跟红袖阁的表态再次不平静了，更是有些小家族因为海家的表态考虑是否应该重新站队。
此刻的变故是南宫傲没有想到的，他还是小看了长孙。
“长孙，你真的出乎我的意料。”
“我刚才说过了，没看清形势的可能是你。”长孙即使此时占了上风依旧很平静。
“但你依旧当不了家主，你应该明白我指的是什么。”南宫傲说道。
此时看到自己主子吃瘪，蒙执也跟着着急，南宫傲此话一出，蒙执也明白了南宫傲的意思，激动的说道：“对，你不能修炼，那你就没有资格担任家主。”
蒙执一语点出长孙的硬伤，即使有再多人支持长孙，但长孙若不能修炼，那连天行者便很难领导，更别提担任家主了。
此时长孙反而更加平静，大厅内也陷入了沉默，所有人都在等长孙的回应。
就在所有人都在考虑长孙该怎么应对时，长孙忽然动了。
只见长孙一步跃上议事桌，向蒙执冲去，几步之内竟形成雷霆之势，声势浩大让人震惊。
但在五步之后长孙竟如同离弦的箭，速度之快让人意想不到，而且最后两步竟悄无声息，巨大的反差让人措手不及；待人反应过来长孙已到蒙执身前，右拳已到眼前。
吃惊的蒙执没有想到长孙会忽然向他动手。
而长孙速度之快，声势之大也让他始料未及，最后只得面前举掌反击。
虽然只是匆忙还击，但蒙执毕竟是术者境的高手，而长孙连行者第一层都未突破。
境界上的巨大差距依旧难以逾越，长孙仓促的退回原位，蒙执也狼狈的退后了两步才止住颓势。
“你身为继承人，竟然行偷袭这等卑鄙之举！”蒙执此时已经出离了愤怒。
长孙气息有些急促，但依旧平静的说道：“你身为副将，连自己的兵符都保护不住，有什么资格继续担任副将。”
长孙摊开自己的左手露出手中的兵符。
content_en:
At this time, Nangong Ao was so angry with his eldest grandson that he didn't know how to retort.
Meng Zhi, on the other hand, protected the master at the right time and said, "Young master, how could you be so unreasonable to our ancestor and deputy captain!"
“那你又有什么资格这样对我说话？”长孙平静的反问，
Meng Zhi suddenly blushed.
"Okay, Meng Zhi, step back." After a while, Nangong Ao regained his composure.
"Changsun, I underestimated you. It seems that you have learned some skills in the slums in the past few months, but I am afraid that your position as the heir may not be preserved today." Nangong Ao said calmly at this moment, but the straightforwardness of his words showed that he was about to pierce the last window sticker.
Seeing Nangong Ao's calmness at this time, Changsun knew that his strategy was probably useless, and said, "What can the deputy captain say? Why can't I keep it?"
“此刻的形势你还看不清楚么？”南宫傲双手一摊，此刻支持南宫傲的势力都看着长孙，形势已经很明显了。
"I think it's you who may not have seen clearly." Changsun was unmoved.
“南宫副团长，我认为长孙家主身体尚好，此时提继承人的事怕是不合适。”
"Moreover, the eldest son of the family is wise and brave, and has a unique vision for people. Wasn't the deputy captain promoted by the eldest son of the family, and you have proved that the eldest son of the family has a correct vision. I believe that the young master of the eldest sun will not let him down." Siqin said at this time, his tone was hard to find fault with, but his attitude was also very clear.
南宫傲没有想到此时竟然有人会站出来支持长孙。
"Miss Siqin, what do you mean?"
“我的意思副团长应该已经明白，这也是红袖阁的意思。”司琴接着回答道。
"The Hai family believes that Miss Siqin is right, and the Hai family is willing to fully support Hongxiu Pavilion's decision." Hai Dafu, the head of the Hai family, said.
海家在丽山城内一直算是不问世事的家族，只经商不参与城内的家族纷争，这是海家一贯的态度。
The Hai family doesn't speak, but no one would think that the Hai family has no right to speak, and no one dares to look down on the Hai family.
The Hai family is one of the richest families in the city. This can be seen from the names of the family heads in the past generations. The head of the Hai family this generation is called Hai Dafu, and his father is named Hai Jufu.
No one knows how much money the Hai family has, and no one knows how deep the Hai family's background is. They only know that the Hai family cannot be messed with.
At this time, everyone was surprised that the Haijia took sides. No one thought that the Haijia would express their attitude in such a meeting, and no one thought that the Haijia would support the Red Sleeve Pavilion.
From what the head of the Hai family just said, it can be seen that the Hai family seems to have an unusual relationship with Hongxiu Pavilion.
At this time, people were even more afraid of Hongxiu Pavilion.
The heads of the families in the venue were once again uneasy because of the statements made by the Hai family and Hongxiuge Pavilion. Some small families were even considering whether they should re-align with the statements made by the Hai family.
The change at this moment was something Nangong Ao didn't expect, and he still underestimated his eldest grandson.
"Changsun, you really exceeded my expectations."
"As I said just now, you might be the one who didn't see the situation clearly." Changsun remained calm even though he had the upper hand.
"But you still can't be the head of the family. You should understand what I mean." Nangong Ao said.
Seeing that his master was defeated, Meng Zhi became anxious. As soon as Nangong Ao said this, Meng Zhi also understood what Nangong Ao meant and said excitedly: "Yes, if you can't practice, then you are not qualified to be the head of the family."
Meng Zhi pointed out the shortcomings of the eldest grandson. No matter how many people support the eldest grandson, if the eldest grandson cannot practice, it will be difficult for him to lead the Skywalker, let alone serve as the head of the family.
At this time, Changsun became calmer, and the hall fell into silence. Everyone was waiting for Changsun's response.
Just when everyone was thinking about how the eldest grandson should respond, the eldest grandson suddenly moved.
I saw the eldest grandson leaping up to the discussion table and askingMeng Zhi rushed forward, and within a few steps a thunderous force formed, which was so powerful that people were shocked.
But after five steps, Changsun was like an arrow leaving the string. The speed was unexpected, and the last two steps were silent. The huge contrast caught people off guard. When people realized that Changsun was in front of Meng Zhi, his right fist was already in front of him.
The surprised Meng Zhi did not expect that Changsun would suddenly attack him.
However, Changsun's speed and momentum caught him by surprise, and in the end he had no choice but to raise his palms in front of him to fight back.
Although he only fought back in a hurry, Meng Zhi was a master of the magician realm after all, and Changsun didn't even break through the first level of the practitioner.
The huge gap in realm was still insurmountable. Changsun hurriedly retreated to his original position, and Meng Zhi also took two embarrassing steps back before stopping his decline.
"As the heir, you actually carried out such a despicable act as a sneak attack!" Meng Zhi was already furious at this time.
Changsun's breath was a little short, but he still said calmly: "As a deputy general, you can't even protect your own military talisman. What qualifications do you have to continue to be a deputy general."
Changsun spread out his left hand to reveal the military talisman in his hand.
